title: 第11章 隐藏境界第12章 以势压人
content_zh:
“这小子的战斗意识很强，看穿了你们的弱点！”
林五能在林天浩身边呆那么多年，也不是浪得虚名之辈，一眼就看出了问题所在。
“该死，怪不得能杀死林虎少爷！此子断不可留！”
几人都感觉到了林炎的威胁，放任林炎成长下去，恐怕还真会成为天龙剑宗的天才。
“你们不觉得，现在你们更应该考虑的是自己的性命？”
林炎讥讽。
吼！
九条金色圣龙咆哮，堪比玄阶圆满的拳法，再配合大乘符师的精神力，林炎的招数无比的凶悍，那几位林家护卫全部都被打的吐血。
几位护卫惊骇，只能求助林五：“林五大人，此子恐怕得您亲自动手了……”
“一群蠢货，连一个小辈都打不过，都给我闪开！”
林五低喝，扑杀而来。
他的修为，比那几位林家护卫并不算强太多，只是气海三重。
可他的招数和眼界，却比那几位林家护卫强太多了，每一招每一式都透着杀伐，非常的凶悍。
即便是林炎，遇到林五，也都感觉到了一阵棘手。
“血龙拳印！”
林炎不断爆发绝招。
而林五也施展杀招，与之对拼，两人战斗无比的激烈。
砰砰砰！
十招、三十招、五十招……四周的山林都被真气摧毁的一片狼藉，而两大高手却越战越猛。
“不愧是林五大人，实战比我们强太多了！”

那几位林家护卫都露出敬畏之色。
“这小畜生也有点离谱，竟然以养气九重跟林五大人交战到这种程度！”
林炎的实力，也让人吃惊。
养气九重，气海三重，差了四个小境界啊！
林炎却逆伐，太离谱了！
换做别的天才，早就败下阵来了。
不过虽然惊叹于林炎的表现，但这些护卫却对林五有着绝对的信心：
“此子毕竟只是养气境，凭借武学优势，短时间内或许能跟林五大人对拼，可时间长了，此子必定会因为耗尽真气而死！”
实际上，林炎也知道这一点。
他感受着体内真气的消耗，内心无比的焦急：
“养气境始终只是养气境，体内真气稀薄，哪怕我的武脉是圣龙武脉，但真气雄浑程度也就和气海一重差不多。林五是气海三重的高手，真气磅礴程度是我的三倍，如果持久战下去，我必败无疑！”
“必须得想办法，尽快结束战斗！”
忽然的，似乎想到了什么，林炎眼神锐利，他手中结印，一道淡淡的光印猛地打出：
“灵符印记！”
这是从林家老祖那得到的符典，小灵符术，能够激发精神波动。
这股精神波动只是大乘初期，对应着气海三重，还无法灭杀林五，但却可以让林五的精神遭受冲击。
“这是什么手段？”
一瞬间林五只感觉头晕目眩，好似被人敲了闷棍似的。
“就是现在！”
林炎抓住机会，猛地一拳打出，轰在了林五脑袋上。

如果林五全盛时期，自然是可以用修为硬抗这一拳的，但此刻林五精神受创，跟喝醉了似的，根本无法及时做出反应。
噗！
这一拳之下，林五的脑袋裂开，鲜血狂喷。
“不好！”
林五虽不知道精神力是怎么回事，但也意识到林炎的手段诡异，会让他陷入混乱之中，战斗下去必死无疑。
content_en:
"This kid has a strong sense of combat and has seen through your weaknesses!"
Lin Wu could stay by Lin Tianhao's side for so many years, and he was not a wasted person. He could see the problem at a glance.
"Damn it, no wonder I can kill Master Lin Hu! This boy must not be kept!"
Several people felt the threat from Lin Yan. If Lin Yan was allowed to grow, he might really become a genius of the Tianlong Sword Sect.
"Don't you think that what you should consider more now is your own life?"
Lin Yan sneered.
roar!
The nine golden holy dragons roared, which was comparable to the perfect boxing skills of Xuanjie. Coupled with the spiritual power of the Mahayana Talisman Master, Lin Yan's moves were extremely fierce, and all the Lin family guards were beaten until they vomited blood.
Several guards were horrified and could only ask Lin Wu for help: "Lord Lin Wu, I'm afraid you have to do it yourself..."
"A bunch of idiots who can't even beat a junior, get out of my way!"
Lin Wu drank low and came to kill him.
His cultivation level is not much better than those of the Lin family guards, who are only at the third level of Qi Sea.
But his moves and vision were much better than those of the Lin family guards. Every move and style was full of killing power, very fierce.
Even Lin Yan felt troubled when he met Lin Wu.
"Blood Dragon Fist Seal!"
Lin Yan kept unleashing his unique moves.
Lin Wu also used his killing moves to fight against him, and the battle between the two was extremely fierce.
Bang bang bang!
Ten moves, thirty moves, fifty moves... The surrounding mountains and forests were in a mess destroyed by the true energy, but the two masters fought more and more fiercely.
"As expected of Master Lin Wu, he is much better than us in actual combat!"
The Lin family guards all looked in awe.
"This little beast is a bit outrageous. He actually used the ninth level of nourishing qi to fight Master Lin Wu to such an extent!"
Lin Yan's strength is also surprising.
The ninth level of nourishing qi and the third level of qi sea are four small realms short of each other!
Lin Yan went against the trend, which was outrageous!
Any other genius would have been defeated long ago.
However, although they were amazed by Lin Yan's performance, these guards had absolute confidence in Lin Wu:
"After all, this child is only in the Qi-nurturing realm. With his martial arts advantages, he may be able to compete with Master Lin Wu in a short time, but if time goes by, this child will definitely die from exhausting his true energy!"
In fact, Lin Yan also knew this.
He felt the consumption of true energy in his body, and felt extremely anxious:
"The Qi-nourishing state is always just the Qi-nourishing state, and the true energy in the body is thin. Even if my martial arteries are the Holy Dragon martial arts, the true energy is about the same as the first level of the Qi Sea. Lin Wu is a master of the third level of the Qi Sea, and the true energy is three times as powerful as mine. If I continue to fight for a long time, I will definitely lose!"
"We must find a way to end the battle as soon as possible!"
Suddenly, as if he thought of something, Lin Yan's eyes were sharp, he formed a seal in his hand, and a faint light seal suddenly shot out:
"Spirit mark!"
This is a talisman obtained from the ancestor of the Lin family. It is a small spiritual talisman that can stimulate mental fluctuations.
This mental fluctuation is only in the early stage of Mahayana, corresponding to the third level of Qi and Sea. It cannot kill Lin Wu yet, but it can shock Lin Wu's spirit.
"What method is this?"
For a moment, Lin Wu felt dizzy, as if someone had hit him with a sap.
"Now!"
Lin Yan seized the opportunity and punched Lin Wu on the head.
If Lin Wu was in his prime, he would naturally be able to use his cultivation to resist this punch, but at this moment, Lin Wu was mentally traumatized, as if he was drunk, and could not react in time at all.
puff!
Under this punch, Lin Wu's head split open and blood spurted out.
"Not good!"
Although Lin Wu didn't know what mental power was, he also realized that Lin Yan's strange methods would plunge him into chaos, and he would definitely die if he continued to fight.
